text:
ana: Quick plan — 3-slide benchmark webinar: SMB chat, mid-market chat, bulk embeddings. Keep narrative tight: latency (avg vs p95), $/1k tokens sensitivity, and a funnel mapping latency savings -> dev hours saved.

mike: For visuals, I can do grouped bars (avg vs p95), a line with a quantization ribbon for cost, and a simple funnel svg. Need CSV + palette.

ana: CSV to use:
scenario,avg_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,tokens_per_call
smb_chat,130,400,0.52,320
mid_chat,90,225,0.68,410
embeddings_bulk,40,105,0.28,5000

priya: Messaging tip: say "seconds saved per 1k requests" and convert to monthly engineer-hours or ops $ saved. Keep CTAs razor short.

logan: Routing: CTA links append ?bench_seg=smb|mid|emb; Zapier posts to HubSpot, set lead.segment and lifecycle=MQL. SMB -> self-serve trial drip; Mid -> demo booking; Embeddings -> whitepaper + SDR nurture.

design-bot: Palette uploaded to drive — primary #0b5fff, secondary #00b389, accent #ff7a59. Use 30% darker for p95.

mike: Ill mock the three charts tonight. Need final CTAs by 3pm PT so design can layout slides.

ana: Agreed. Ill add a tiny appendix slide with raw numbers and test harness assumptions (model family, seq len, tokens/call). Also a 2-paragraph host script.

deploy-bot: Webinar page test passed (3/3 checks) :white_check_mark:.

priya: Final CTAs (short):
- SMB: "Ship faster — 14-day free instance"
- Mid: "Predictable latency + controls — book a demo"
- Embeddings: "Lower embeddings cost at scale — download benchmark"

logan: Routing config draft going to staging tomorrow AM. Will include Zapier mapping & HubSpot fields.

mike: Uploaded first draft visuals to the drive, pinged design for color tweaks. :eyes:
